sentence_stem: I need to buy some eggs,
correct_completion: so I will go to the supermarket.
full_sentence: I need to buy some eggs, so I will go to the supermarket.
acceptable_variants: so I am going to the shop later.
so I will stop at the store on my way home.

options.why_wrong: 'Although' shows contrast, but the stem needs a result of needing eggs, not a contrast.
'But' introduces a problem, not the action that follows from needing eggs.

options.text: so I will go to the supermarket.
because I like eggs very much.
options.why_wrong: This gives a reason for liking eggs, not a result of needing to buy them.

explanation: 'So' introduces a result of the first clause, so the completion must give the natural consequence of needing something. Portuguese speakers may confuse 'so' with 'because' here, since both connect two clauses.
translation: Preciso comprar alguns ovos, então vou ao supermercado.
